item.description: surprise billing p39, (and chapter 6 too), reading a note about a 2015 study that found, 30% of plans on federal marketplqce, wow, without any emergency physician coverage?! so all those would be out of network. cost sharing p40, cost sharing like HDHP, intended to reduce cost by getting people to shop around more. item.title: Recruiting Is Not a Science
item.description: The chaos of hiring is perpetually on most peoples minds these days, at least in my sampling of the conversations I engage in. One topic that comes up a lot is job post ghosting. No need to mention AI. Oops just did 😅. 👻 job post ghosting: an applicant does not hear back from an entity behind an application they submitted, for an extended period of time. The entity where an application is submitted may as well be a coin in a fountain or a letter in an ocean bottle or some other kind of void.

item.title: What are the important problems to solve these days?
item.description: Housing scarcity VC funds are buying up private properties, taking housing off the market, driving up housing costs through additional scarcity and pushing more people to renting. Also, shared algorithms for rent pricing are a proxy for collusion, possibly inadvertent, but raising prices. Loneliness Health insurance disconnect We have new transparency laws passed but perhaps people dont know about them yet. Not yet transitioned to vqlue based cqre, so many providers are incentivized to paper patients with mountqins of itemization paper cuts.
